info.title: ROOTOPATHY CareOS Foundation API
info.description: Checked contract for the currently implemented public foundation, browser identity with approved role-level MFA enforcement, approved-registry governed invitations, maker-checker MFA and membership administration, membership-backed organization selection and access projection, and bounded organization-core administration endpoints with the exact approved readiness, organization-profile, registration-identifier, effective address/contact, and versioned international-settings contracts. Unsafe browser operations require an approved Origin or Referer plus the double-submit CSRF cookie/header pair.

get.description: Creates or reuses an anonymous session, sets the readable XSRF-TOKEN cookie, and returns the matching raw token for an SPA request header.

200.description: Anonymous, MFA challenge, mandatory MFA enrollment, or fully authenticated session state

post.description: Always returns the same accepted response so account existence is not disclosed.
Starts recent-authenticated TOTP enrollment for either a fully authenticated account or a restricted session whose approved active role mandates MFA.
Enables the pending TOTP method and returns one-time recovery codes. A mandatory-enrollment session is atomically upgraded to fully authenticated after verification.

get.description: Returns only organizations for which the authenticated actor has a currently active and effective membership. A stored selection is a UX preference and is not authorization evidence.

200.description: Selectable organizations for the current actor

post.description: Stores a server-side organization preference only after rechecking a live membership under actor-bound RLS. The preference never replaces route-level authorization.
Consumes one exact unexpired token once. A matching existing account must authenticate; otherwise a new account is created under the password policy.

200.description: Invitation linked to the authenticated existing account

201.description: Invitation accepted and a new account created

post.description: Issues and delivers one bounded invitation only after permission, delegation, reason, recent-authentication, and recent-MFA checks; business state and governance evidence commit atomically.
Revokes one pending invitation after recent-authentication and recent-MFA checks, with caller-controlled idempotency and atomic audit/outbox evidence.
Creates a time-bounded MFA reset request for an MFA-enabled active organization member after permission, reason, recent-authentication, and recent-MFA checks.
Records a recent-MFA-authenticated independent decision by an authorized account other than the original requester; approval does not reset MFA.
Consumes the exact independent approval only for its recent-MFA-authenticated original requester and atomically revokes the target MFA material and sessions with governance evidence.

Creates an immutable, time-bounded request for an exact non-owner role change or revocation after permission, reason, recent-authentication, recent-MFA, delegation, target-separation, and membership-revision checks.
Records a recent-MFA-authenticated decision by an authorized owner distinct from both the original requester and target member; approval does not change access.
Consumes the exact independent approval only for its recent-MFA-authenticated original requester and atomically applies the requested role change or revocation with governance evidence.

Creates an immutable, time-bounded request for an exact owner promotion or demotion after owner permission, reason, recent-authentication, recent-MFA, target-separation, approved-role, and membership-revision checks.
Records a recent-MFA-authenticated decision by an authorized owner distinct from both the original requester and target member; approval does not change owner access.

Consumes the exact independent approval only for its recent-MFA-authenticated original owner requester and atomically applies the requested owner promotion or demotion with final-owner protection and governance evidence.

get.description: Returns a minimum-necessary, snapshot-classified cursor page of organization memberships. Filters are allow-listed, cursors are signed and bound to the tenant and filters, and action keys are projected from current server authorization rather than inferred by the client.

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Normalized literal search across member display name and email.

parameters.name: state
parameters.description: Derived access-state filter evaluated at the page snapshot time.

parameters.name: roleKey
parameters.description: Exact active interactive role key from the approved registry.

get.description: Returns the bounded server-calculated Module 1 setup gates and administration counts. Not-yet-implemented approved gates remain explicit and cannot be treated as activation approval.

200.description: Facility draft updated or exact idempotent response replayed
Complete facility draft submitted or exact idempotent response replayed

get.description: Returns the effective and scheduled international-settings versions, server-owned impact rules, and locale-library format previews after tenant authorization.

put.description: Schedules one future immutable settings version with a strong entity tag, idempotency, explicit reason, and exact governance evidence.

200.description: Settings version scheduled or exact idempotent response replayed

get.description: Returns the bounded organization identity and international baseline after tenant authorization.

put.description: Updates the bounded approved organization profile using a strong entity tag, caller-retained idempotency key, explicit reason, atomic governance evidence, and tenant authorization.

200.description: Organization profile updated or an exact idempotent response replayed

get.description: Returns the minimum-necessary organization identifier projection and live server-authorized actions.

post.description: Creates a governed identifier draft with tenant authorization, caller-owned idempotency, an explicit reason, and atomic evidence.

201.description: Identifier draft created or exact response replayed

put.description: Updates only an identifier draft using its strong revision, caller-owned idempotency, explicit reason, and atomic evidence.

200.description: Identifier draft updated or exact response replayed

post.description: Verifies the exact draft revision with bounded evidence reference, MFA, recent authentication, caller-owned idempotency, and atomic evidence.

200.description: Identifier verified or exact response replayed

post.description: Revokes an eligible verified identifier without rewriting history and preserves any required current primary replacement.

200.description: Identifier revoked or exact response replayed

post.description: Atomically supersedes an eligible verified identifier with a separately verified same-type replacement using strong revisions for both records, caller-owned idempotency, and immutable evidence.

200.description: Identifier superseded or exact response replayed

post.description: Creates a governed effective organization address with caller-owned idempotency, an explicit reason, and atomic evidence.

201.description: Organization address created or exact response replayed

post.description: Atomically supersedes an effective address with an immutable same-type replacement using a strong revision and explicit reason.

201.description: Replacement address created or exact response replayed

post.description: Ends an active organization address at database time without deleting or rewriting its history.

200.description: Organization address ended or exact response replayed

get.description: Returns governed effective addresses, masked contacts, migration-owned metadata, and live server-authorized actions.

200.description: Current governed organization address and masked-contact projection

post.description: Creates a governed contact while returning only its masked projection and keeping confidential values out of evidence.

201.description: Organization contact created or exact response replayed

post.description: Records verification of the exact current contact revision without exposing its confidential normalized value.

200.description: Organization contact verified or exact response replayed

post.description: Atomically supersedes an effective contact with an unverified same-purpose replacement and immutable lineage.

201.description: Replacement contact created or exact response replayed

post.description: Ends an active organization contact at database time without deleting or rewriting its history.

200.description: Organization contact ended or exact response replayed

sessionCookie.name: CAREOS_SESSION
sessionCookie.description: Opaque HttpOnly SameSite=Strict server-side session identifier. Secure is mandatory outside explicit local HTTP development.

csrfCookie.name: XSRF-TOKEN
csrfCookie.description: Readable SameSite=Strict double-submit token cookie. Secure is mandatory outside explicit local HTTP development.

csrfHeader.name: X-XSRF-TOKEN
csrfHeader.description: Must match the raw XSRF-TOKEN cookie value.

BrowserOrigin.name: Origin
BrowserOrigin.description: Must exactly match a configured CareOS browser origin. A same-origin Referer is accepted when Origin is unavailable.

OrganizationId.name: organizationId
OrganizationId.description: Organization boundary for every protected business-resource route.

TargetUserId.name: targetUserId
TargetUserId.description: Opaque identifier of the organization member whose MFA is being administered.

MembershipId.name: membershipId
MembershipId.description: Opaque identifier of an organization membership.

ApprovalId.name: approvalId
ApprovalId.description: Opaque identifier of a time-bounded independent approval workflow.

Cursor.name: cursor
Cursor.description: Opaque continuation cursor returned by the preceding page. Clients must not parse or construct it.

Limit.name: limit
Limit.description: Maximum number of records requested for one cursor page.

IfMatch.name: If-Match
IfMatch.description: Strong entity tag from the latest representation. Required for protected updates and deletes.

IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKey.description: Caller-generated key for an explicitly retryable protected mutation. Reuse is valid only for an equivalent request.

CorrelationId.description: Stable identifier used to correlate one HTTP request across logs and problem responses.

RetryAfter.description: Bounded delay in seconds before the caller may retry an eligible request.

ETag.description: Strong entity tag for optimistic concurrency.

SessionExpiresIn.description: Effective seconds remaining before the authenticated browser session reaches its idle or absolute deadline. Omitted when no authenticated session exists.

Set-Cookie.description: Contains the rotated CAREOS_SESSION cookie and may expire the prior CSRF cookie.

MfaPendingSession.description: Primary credentials accepted; an MFA challenge or mandatory authenticator enrollment is required

Set-Cookie.description: Contains the rotated CAREOS_SESSION cookie and may expire the prior CSRF cookie.

RecoveryCodes.description: New one-time recovery codes; each plaintext code is returned only in this response

Accepted.description: Request accepted without disclosing whether an account exists

BadRequest.description: Request validation, password policy, or one-time-token failure

Unauthorized.description: Credentials, verification evidence, or session is invalid

Forbidden.description: Origin, CSRF, or authorization check failed

NotFound.description: The resource is unavailable or hidden from the current actor

Conflict.description: The requested transition, idempotency key, or current resource state conflicts with the operation

PreconditionRequired.description: A required precondition is missing, such as recent authentication, recent MFA, or If-Match

PreconditionFailed.description: The supplied entity tag no longer matches the current representation

ServiceUnavailable.description: The service is temporarily unable to process this request

InternalError.description: The request failed without exposing sensitive implementation details.

mfaRequired.description: True when at least one currently effective approved membership role mandates MFA.

editable.description: True only when the current actor has the live organization.profile.manage permission.

evidenceReference.description: Confidential bounded evidence reference projected only to actors with live verification permission.

supersedesId.description: The immutable predecessor linked by an atomic supersession, when this identifier is a replacement.

availableActions.description: Actions derived from live permission, lifecycle, and primary-replacement policy.

canCreate.description: True only when the actor has live manage permission and an applicable active type exists.

publicProjectionAllowed.description: Migration-owned policy flag. False for the approved operational purpose.

maskedValue.description: Minimum-necessary masked projection; the confidential normalized value is never returned.

value.description: Confidential value normalized and validated according to channel; never projected back.
